title: Customization group header
description: A group header row in a customization list (`.ai-customization-group-header`): twistie, label, count pill and hover actions (+ New/Add, ↻ Check for and Apply Updates on Plugins).
usage: Direct child of <vsc-customization-list>, before its rows. Product groups: User, Workspace, Plugins, Remote, Extensions, Built-in (prompts); User, Workspace, Plugins, Built-In (MCP); User, Workspace (Plugins).

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Group codicon (prompts: ai-customization-user; mcp/plugins: account, folder, plug).

attributes.name: first
attributes.description: First group (36px); later groups are 40px with `.has-previous-group`.

attributes.name: add-label
attributes.description: Aria label of the + action, e.g. New Skill, Add Server, Install Plugin from Source.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Defaults to the enclosing list's kind.

examples.title: Plugin groups
